confirmedFindings.title: Ecto N+1 sequential association query in enumeration loop
confirmedFindings.body: Calling Repo.all(Ecto.assoc(org, :members)) inside Enum.map executes N queries for N organizations instead of preloading associations in a single query.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Use Repo.preload(orgs, :members) or Ecto.Query.preload/2 in the initial query.
